name: DateTime
description: A date or a time, written for whoever is reading: in their language and on their wall clock, inside a real `<time datetime>` that keeps the exact value for a machine.

props.name: value
props.description: What to show: any ISO string, a `Date` or epoch milliseconds. Nothing is rendered for a non-value.

props.name: zone
props.description: Whose wall clock an instant is shown on. Default `'local'`, the reader's. A date or a time has no zone.

props.name: locale
props.description: The reader's language. Default the reader's own.

props.name: format
props.description: How to write it — `{ dateStyle: 'long' }`, `{ month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }`. Default by kind.

props.name: relative
props.description: `3 minutes ago`, `tomorrow` instead of the date. An object passes `now`, `numeric` and `style`.

a11y: The text is what is read out; `datetime` carries the canonical value for anything that parses the page.
